title: THE LOCK-ON IS ONE LOW SIREN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: whichever robot is beeping, it sounds annoying when they get together and the beeping is inconsistent, it needs to be more of a low siren. Since v24.59 every machine gave its own short high double beep the moment it locked on to you, a quarter second apart, so a room of machines turning at once was a scatter of chirps that never sounded the same twice. Now there is one siren: a soft, low wail that rises and falls on a steady beat of about a second and a half, and it plays for as long as at least one machine is on you. Two machines or ten are still the same one siren, a little faster and a little louder with more of them, never a pile of tones. It sits on the side of the nearest machine that is on you, muffled when that machine is behind a wall, fades in and out over about a third of a second, and stops the moment none is on you, when the raid ends and when you pause. In two player, each window hears the siren for the machines on its own player. The old beep is gone.
now: When machines lock on to you, you now hear one low siren that wails while they are on you, the same every time however many there are, instead of a scatter of beeps.
